coverage_limits: All Q1/Q2 claims are scoped to S003 as captured (sha256 5d8b2408...; Final Community Group Report, 8 September 2026; version 0.5 through 0.5.2). No live verification of https://ngff.openmicroscopy.org/0.5/ was possible or attempted; the catalog marks the URI capture-only.
The Zarr v3 specification is referenced but not admitted: chunk grids, codecs, chunk key encodings, storage transformers and array zarr.json details could not be verified beyond S003 L67-72, L99-100.
Section 4 Implementations says only 'See Tools' (S003 L813-814): no reader or writer implementation is present in the corpus, so no claim about any specific tool's behavior is supported or made.
No conformance test suite or normative schema is included in the corpus; none is referenced.
OME-XML obligations beyond the <MetadataOnly/> requirement (S003 L257-260) and full omero/rdefs semantics (S003 L424-425) are unadmitted dependencies.
UDUNITS-2 grammar beyond the enumerated unit strings (S003 L170-172) is unverified.
No keyword searches were relied upon for absence claims; coverage was by full linear reads of all 896 lines in two phases. Negative claims are limited to this inspected capture.
undeveloped_leads: NGFF Tools/implementations listing (S003 L813-814 points to it) - needed for any real-tool interoperability claims; outside admitted corpus.
RFC 2119 full text (S003 L896) - normative baseline for keyword interpretation; not admitted.
Upcoming NGFF specification that will replace bioformats2raw.layout with explicit metadata (S003 L180-181) - forward compatibility unobservable here.
OMERO WebGateway documentation for complete omero/rdefs field semantics (S003 L424-425).
UDUNITS-2 specification for validating or converting unit strings beyond the listed set (S003 L170-172).
Zarr v3 specification (S003 L67-69) for chunk addressing, codecs and storage transformers relevant to the plan's background-read design.
